import json
import sys
path, expected_id, previous_count, backup_tag, *expected_paths = sys.argv[1:]
with open(path, encoding='<redacted literal>') as handle:
    snapshots = json.load(handle)
if len(snapshots) != int(previous_count) + 1:
    raise SystemExit('<redacted literal>')
matching = [item for item in snapshots if item.get('id') == expected_id]
if len(matching) != 1:
    raise SystemExit('<redacted literal>')
snapshot = matching[0]
if snapshot.get('hostname') != 'passvero-production':
    raise SystemExit('<redacted literal>')
if set(snapshot.get('tags') or []) != {'passvero-postgresql', backup_tag}:
    raise SystemExit('<redacted literal>')
if set(snapshot.get('paths') or []) != set(expected_paths):
    raise SystemExit('<redacted literal>')
print(snapshot['time'])
